# Fix My Violation

> Property cleanup and sourced, plain-English overgrown-property code-enforcement information for Tampa Bay. Not a government agency or law firm.

Call 813-671-2757 or request help at https://fixmyviolation.com/fix-my-violation/. Serving Hillsborough, Pinellas and Manatee counties. Services: emergency overgrown-lot mowing, bush hogging, brush/underbrush clearing, debris and yard-waste removal, before/after photos, recurring maintenance. Scheduling and compliance are not guaranteed by an inquiry.

Guides last reviewed October 7, 2026. Use the issuing agency, current ordinance and actual notice. County standards do not automatically apply inside cities.
